subtitle: Private Residential Compound
script: A timeless courtyard living experience, where privacy, nature and tradition come together.
summary: Three villas around a central courtyard garden.

texts.heading: Design Overview
texts.body: A private three-villa compound designed around a central courtyard, creating a serene and cohesive living environment. The layout prioritizes family life, hospitality and outdoor living, with a strong sense of privacy and connection to nature.

texts.heading: Site & Landscape
items: Central landscaped garden with lush greenery and palm trees.
Pathways linking the villas and outdoor spaces.
Seating areas for relaxation and gatherings.
Water features (fountain and pool) visible within the central garden.

texts.heading: Architectural Character
items: Arcaded elevations with elegant arches and traditional proportions.
Warm masonry and plaster palette with natural textures.
Courtyard language that celebrates privacy, light and openness.

texts.heading: Outdoor Amenities
items: Central swimming pool for recreation and relaxation.
Shaded seating areas and gathering spaces.
Landscape features and fountains enhance the outdoor experience.

texts.heading: Design Priorities
items: Privacy and security for all three villas.
Lush landscape and water features for a serene environment.
